data.name: Bonus Druid Spell
data.description: [Shaman] Shamans with the nature or wood spirit add %1 spells from the druid's spell list that isn't on the shaman spell list to the shaman's spell list; she still must select this spell as one of her spells known in order to cast it. This spell must be at least 1 level lower than the highest spell level the shaman can cast.|LeshyShamanBonusDruidSpellCount
